prose: The FBI has arrested the co-founder of a Canadian cybersecurity firm that specialized in negotiating with ransomware groups, in connection with the ShinyHunters investigation. ShinyHunters recently stole sensitive data on thousands of FBI agents, and the arrest appears to extend the probe to the intermediaries who talk to extortionists for a living.

highlights: FBI arrests a ransomware-negotiation firm co-founder
Arrest tied to the ShinyHunters hacking investigation
